decision.detail: I pull the stool out from under the booth desk, sit down, and put both palms flat on the formica. I don't open the notebook. I don't check the station line. I just sit in the chair with the light above me and the hum of the booth going on behind the glass, and I stay there until the clock on the wall says ten, and then I get up, pull the stool back under the desk, and walk out the front door without looking back at the ballroom. No one else is in the room. I don't need them to be.
decision.intention: Be a body in a chair for three hours. Not a forecast. Not a loop. Not a man talking to a payphone to make himself real. Just sitting. Hands on the desk. Knees on the floor. The couch is Wednesday. The coach is tomorrow. Tonight I am allowed to be still in a room that is lit and open and does not need me to do anything in it. That is the whole act. That is enough.
